turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My grandson keeps telling me to do online banking. Is it safe?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's generally very safe if you use your bank's official app or website and keep your password private.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I worry about those scam messages.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a smart worry. Your bank will never ask for your full password or ask you to move money by text or phone call.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What if someone calls pretending to be the bank?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hang up and call the number on the back of your card yourself. If it was real, they'll still be there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's a good tip. I'll write

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: that down on the notepad by the phone.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lovely idea. And let your grandson help set it up, so you have someone to ask.
